purpose: Verify that Faculty, Dept_Admin, and HOD are permitted to create and publish department announcements.
preconditions: Department exists with authenticated users holding Faculty, Dept_Admin, and HOD roles.
action_or_input: Each authorized actor (Faculty, Dept_Admin, HOD) submits a valid department announcement with content and target-scope criteria.
expected_result: Each announcement creation is permitted and published in the department.

purpose: Verify that roles other than Faculty, Dept_Admin, and HOD (such as Student) are denied from creating department announcements.
preconditions: Department exists with an authenticated Student user.
action_or_input: Student attempts to create and publish a department announcement.
expected_result: The request is denied and no announcement is created or published.

purpose: Verify that an announcement is shown when the viewer matches its applicable role, program, and academic-year targeting criteria.
preconditions: An active announcement exists targeting a specific Role, Program, and Academic Year; an authenticated viewer matches all three targeting criteria.
action_or_input: The matching viewer retrieves the department announcement list and views the announcement details.
expected_result: The announcement is included in the returned list and its details are accessible to the viewer.

purpose: Verify that an announcement is filtered out when the viewer does not match its applicable role, program, or academic-year targeting criteria.
preconditions: An active announcement exists targeting a specific Role, Program, and Academic Year; authenticated viewers exist who mismatch on Role, on Program, or on Academic Year.
action_or_input: Each non-matching viewer retrieves the department announcement list and attempts to view the announcement details.
expected_result: The announcement is excluded from the announcement list and not shown to non-matching viewers.

purpose: Verify that an announcement with required content and sufficient target-scope information is published without requiring a validity period.
preconditions: An authenticated Faculty, Dept_Admin, or HOD user exists in the department.
action_or_input: The authorized actor submits an announcement containing valid content and valid target-scope criteria (Role, Program, Academic Year) with no validity-period field.
expected_result: Validation succeeds and the announcement is published.

purpose: Verify that announcement publication is blocked when required content or target-scope information is missing or invalid.
preconditions: An authenticated Faculty, Dept_Admin, or HOD user exists in the department.
action_or_input: The authorized actor submits an announcement with empty/missing content, or with missing/invalid target-scope information.
expected_result: Publication is blocked with a validation error and no announcement is created.

purpose: Verify that the HOD can edit, hide, and delete active department announcements.
preconditions: Active department announcements exist and an authenticated HOD user is active for the department.
action_or_input: HOD edits one active announcement, hides a second active announcement, and deletes a third active announcement.
expected_result: All three operations succeed: the edited announcement reflects updated content, the hidden announcement is no longer visible as active, and the deleted announcement is removed.

purpose: Verify that non-HOD actors are denied from editing, hiding, or deleting an active department announcement.
preconditions: An active department announcement exists; authenticated non-HOD users (Faculty including the announcement author, Dept_Admin, and Student) exist.
action_or_input: Each non-HOD actor attempts to edit, hide, and delete the active announcement.
expected_result: Every attempt is denied and the active announcement remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify that Faculty can submit a stock request for a department inventory item.
preconditions: A department inventory item exists with available stock; an authenticated Faculty user belongs to the department.
action_or_input: Faculty submits a stock request for the inventory item with a valid available quantity.
expected_result: The stock request is accepted and created.

purpose: Verify that non-Faculty actors are denied from submitting stock requests.
preconditions: A department inventory item exists with available stock; authenticated Student, Dept_Admin, and HOD users exist.
action_or_input: Each non-Faculty actor attempts to submit a stock request for the inventory item.
expected_result: Each request is denied and no stock request record is created.

purpose: Verify that the HOD can approve or reject a pending Faculty stock request.
preconditions: Two pending Faculty stock requests exist awaiting HOD decision; an authenticated active HOD exists for the department.
action_or_input: HOD approves the first pending stock request and rejects the second pending stock request.
expected_result: Both decisions are accepted; the first request transitions to Approved and the second transitions to Rejected.

purpose: Verify that non-HOD actors cannot approve or reject a pending Faculty stock request.
preconditions: A pending Faculty stock request exists; authenticated Dept_Admin, Faculty, and Student users exist.
action_or_input: Each non-HOD actor attempts to approve or reject the pending stock request.
expected_result: Each decision attempt is denied and the stock request remains in pending status.

purpose: Verify that Dept_Admin can issue stock for an HOD-approved stock request and that inventory is decremented.
preconditions: A Faculty stock request for a department inventory item has been approved by the HOD; an authenticated active Dept_Admin exists.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin marks the HOD-approved stock request as Issued.
expected_result: Issuance succeeds, the request status becomes Issued, and the item's inventory quantity is automatically decremented by the issued quantity.

purpose: Verify that Dept_Admin cannot issue stock when the stock request has not been approved by the HOD.
preconditions: A pending stock request and a rejected stock request exist in the department; an authenticated active Dept_Admin exists.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin attempts to issue stock for the pending request and for the rejected request.
expected_result: Both issuance attempts are denied, neither request becomes Issued, and inventory quantity remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify that actors other than Dept_Admin cannot issue stock even when the request is HOD-approved.
preconditions: A Faculty stock request has been approved by the HOD; authenticated HOD, Faculty, and Student users exist.
action_or_input: Each non-Dept_Admin actor attempts to mark the HOD-approved stock request as Issued.
expected_result: Each issuance attempt is denied, the request remains Approved (not Issued), and inventory quantity remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify that authenticated Students and Faculty can submit department feedback.
preconditions: Authenticated Student and Faculty users belong to the department.
action_or_input: Both the Student and the Faculty user each submit department feedback.
expected_result: Both feedback submissions succeed and are stored as new confidential feedback records.

purpose: Verify that unauthenticated users and non-eligible department actors (Dept_Admin, HOD) are denied from submitting feedback.
preconditions: An unauthenticated client and authenticated Dept_Admin and HOD users exist.
action_or_input: The unauthenticated user, Dept_Admin, and HOD each attempt to submit department feedback.
expected_result: All attempts are denied and no feedback records are created.

purpose: Verify that Dept_Admin (including closing simple issues during initial review) and HOD (after initial review) can mark feedback as Resolved or Closed.
preconditions: Feedback items exist: a simple new feedback item for Dept_Admin initial review, and an initially reviewed feedback item available for HOD oversight.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin closes the simple feedback issue during initial review (or marks feedback Resolved/Closed), and HOD marks the initially reviewed feedback as Resolved or Closed.
expected_result: Both terminal status transitions succeed and the feedback records reflect Resolved or Closed status.

purpose: Verify that actors other than Dept_Admin and HOD cannot mark feedback as Resolved or Closed.
preconditions: A submitted feedback item exists; authenticated Student (including the submitter) and Faculty users exist.
action_or_input: Student and Faculty each attempt to mark the feedback item as Resolved or Closed.
expected_result: Both attempts are denied and the feedback status remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify that a conflict-free timetable upload or modification by Dept_Admin is allowed to save.
preconditions: An authenticated active Dept_Admin exists; existing department timetable slots do not overlap with the submitted candidate slots.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin submits a conflict-free class/lab timetable upload or modification.
expected_result: Conflict validation passes and the timetable update is saved.

purpose: Verify that a timetable upload or modification with overlapping slots is blocked from saving.
preconditions: An authenticated active Dept_Admin exists and a timetable schedule is present in the department.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin submits a timetable upload or modification containing overlapping slots.
expected_result: The system detects the overlap, blocks saving with a conflict validation error, and preserves the prior saved timetable unchanged.

purpose: Verify that a Dept_Admin proposal to change an official department detail remains pending and does not take effect before HOD approval.
preconditions: Department has published official details (such as Name and Core Policies); an authenticated active Dept_Admin exists.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin proposes a change to an official department detail (e.g., department Name or Core Policies).
expected_result: The proposed change is recorded in pending HOD-approval status, and the currently published official department detail remains unchanged prior to HOD approval.

purpose: Verify that Headship identity is excluded from the official department-detail proposal path and cannot be independently edited there.
preconditions: Department has an active HOD assigned by the central authority; authenticated Dept_Admin and HOD users exist.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin (or HOD) attempts to submit an official department-detail change to alter the department Headship identity.
expected_result: The edit/proposal is rejected; displayed Headship identity remains derived exclusively from the active central HOD role assignment.

purpose: Verify that Faculty can view department resource information within Faculty scope, including lab resource profiles and relevant issued-stock history.
preconditions: Department lab equipment/resource profiles and issued-stock history relevant to the Faculty user exist; the Faculty user is authenticated.
action_or_input: Faculty requests the department lab resource profiles and issued-stock history views.
expected_result: The system displays the lab resource profiles and the Faculty user's relevant issued-stock history.

purpose: Verify that Faculty resource views exclude resource information outside Faculty scope.
preconditions: Department contains resource/issued-stock records outside the viewing Faculty user's scope (e.g., unrelated issued-stock history of another Faculty member or restricted administrative inventory data).
action_or_input: Authenticated Faculty requests department resource and issued-stock history views.
expected_result: Only resource information within Faculty scope is returned; out-of-scope records are excluded.

purpose: Verify that the HOD can approve or reject pending official department-detail changes.
preconditions: Two pending official department-detail change proposals exist; an authenticated active HOD exists for the department.
action_or_input: HOD approves the first pending official change proposal and rejects the second pending proposal.
expected_result: Both decisions succeed: the approved change becomes effective in published department details, and the rejected change does not take effect.

purpose: Verify that non-HOD actors cannot approve or reject a pending official department-detail change.
preconditions: A pending official department-detail change proposal exists; authenticated Dept_Admin, Faculty, and Student users exist.
action_or_input: Each non-HOD actor attempts to approve or reject the pending official change proposal.
expected_result: Each attempt is denied, the proposal remains pending, and published official department details remain unchanged.

purpose: Verify that a Faculty stock request enters the HOD-approval state when requested quantity equals (or is within) current inventory at submission time.
preconditions: A department inventory item has current available quantity N (e.g., N = 5); an authenticated Faculty user exists.
action_or_input: Faculty submits a stock request for quantity equal to N (5).
expected_result: Availability validation passes and the stock request enters the pending HOD-approval state.

purpose: Verify that a Faculty stock request is blocked from entering the HOD-approval state when requested quantity exceeds current inventory at submission time.
preconditions: A department inventory item has current available quantity N (e.g., N = 5); an authenticated Faculty user exists.
action_or_input: Faculty submits a stock request for quantity N + 1 (6).
expected_result: Availability validation fails, the request is blocked from entering HOD-approval state, and a validation error is returned.

purpose: Verify that every successful stock insertion and stock issuance appends a stock-movement audit log entry.
preconditions: An authenticated active Dept_Admin exists; an HOD-approved stock request exists for an inventory item.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin performs a stock insertion for the inventory item and then issues stock for the HOD-approved request.
expected_result: Two stock-movement log entries are appended to the audit trail: one recording the stock insertion and one recording the stock issuance.

purpose: Verify that existing stock-movement audit log entries cannot be modified or deleted through normal module operations.
preconditions: At least one stock-movement log entry exists from a prior stock insertion or issuance; authenticated Dept_Admin and HOD users exist.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin or HOD attempts to edit or delete the existing stock-movement log entry through module operations.
expected_result: The modification and deletion attempts are rejected/disallowed and the original stock-movement log entry remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify that feedback content is accessible to its submitter (as applicable) and to authorized Dept_Admin and HOD users handling the feedback.
preconditions: A Student or Faculty user has submitted feedback, and Dept_Admin has completed initial review so HOD may also access it for oversight.
action_or_input: The submitter (as applicable), Dept_Admin, and HOD each retrieve the feedback record.
expected_result: Authorized actors can view the feedback content according to their handling/submitter role.

purpose: Verify that feedback content is not exposed to unauthorized users or as general department information.
preconditions: Confidential feedback submitted by a Student or Faculty user exists; another Student and an unrelated Faculty user exist in the same department.
action_or_input: The unrelated Student and unrelated Faculty user attempt to access the feedback directly and query general department information views.
expected_result: Direct access is denied and the feedback content does not appear in general department information views.

purpose: Verify that new feedback is routed to Dept_Admin for initial review, after which HOD may perform oversight or resolution.
preconditions: A newly submitted feedback item exists in New status; authenticated Dept_Admin and HOD users exist.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin performs initial review and categorization on the new feedback, and subsequently HOD accesses the feedback for oversight/resolution.
expected_result: Dept_Admin's initial review is recorded and HOD is then able to view and act on the feedback.

purpose: Verify that HOD oversight/resolution cannot bypass Dept_Admin initial review while feedback is still unreviewed in New status.
preconditions: A newly submitted feedback item exists in New status and has not undergone Dept_Admin initial review; an authenticated HOD exists.
action_or_input: HOD attempts to perform oversight or resolve/close the feedback before Dept_Admin completes initial review.
expected_result: The action is blocked or unavailable until Dept_Admin completes initial review.

purpose: Verify that Students viewing peer and Faculty profiles receive only basic permitted profile information.
preconditions: Department contains peer Student and Faculty profiles with basic, detailed, and privacy-protected sensitive personal data; an authenticated Student exists.
action_or_input: Student requests profile views for a peer Student and a Faculty member.
expected_result: Only basic permitted profile fields are returned; detailed administrative/academic and privacy-protected sensitive fields are omitted.

purpose: Verify that Faculty receive detailed information for Students in their courses and limited permitted information for Faculty/Alumni.
preconditions: Department contains a Student enrolled in the Faculty member's course, a Student not in the Faculty member's course, another Faculty member, and an Alumni profile; the Faculty user is authenticated.
action_or_input: Faculty requests profiles for the enrolled Student, the non-enrolled Student, another Faculty member, and an Alumni member.
expected_result: Faculty receives detailed permitted information for the Student in their course and limited permitted information for Faculty and Alumni, while excluding out-of-scope detailed data for non-enrolled Students and privacy-protected sensitive personal data.

purpose: Verify that HOD and Dept_Admin receive full department user profiles excluding privacy-protected sensitive personal data.
preconditions: Department contains Faculty, Student, and Alumni profiles including privacy-protected sensitive personal data; authenticated HOD and Dept_Admin users exist.
action_or_input: HOD and Dept_Admin each request profiles for Faculty, Student, and Alumni users in the department.
expected_result: Full department profile data is returned to both HOD and Dept_Admin, while privacy-protected sensitive personal data is excluded.

purpose: Verify that the central Institute Admin (or equivalent central authority) can assign or reassign HOD and Dept_Admin roles and that displayed department Headship reflects the active HOD assignment.
preconditions: A department and eligible institute employees exist; an authenticated central Institute Admin user exists.
action_or_input: Central Institute Admin assigns or reassigns the HOD role and Dept_Admin role for the department with valid tenure intervals, then department details are viewed.
expected_result: The role assignments succeed and the department Headship identity displayed by the module matches the newly active HOD assignment.

purpose: Verify that non-central department actors are denied from assigning or reassigning HOD or Dept_Admin roles.
preconditions: Department has active HOD and Dept_Admin assignments; authenticated HOD, Dept_Admin, Faculty, and Student users exist.
action_or_input: Each department-level actor attempts to assign or reassign the HOD or Dept_Admin role.
expected_result: All attempts are denied and existing HOD and Dept_Admin role assignments remain unchanged.

purpose: Verify that a department cannot have more than one active HOD assignment or more than one active Dept_Admin assignment concurrently.
preconditions: Department already has one active HOD assignment and one active Dept_Admin assignment; an authenticated central Institute Admin exists.
action_or_input: Central Institute Admin attempts to create an additional concurrent active HOD assignment (and separately an additional concurrent active Dept_Admin assignment) without ending/replacing the existing active assignment.
expected_result: Both attempts are blocked so the department maintains exactly one active HOD and one active Dept_Admin.

purpose: Verify that a department cannot be left with zero active HOD assignments or zero active Dept_Admin assignments.
preconditions: Department has one active HOD assignment and one active Dept_Admin assignment; an authenticated central Institute Admin exists.
action_or_input: Central Institute Admin attempts to deactivate or remove the sole active HOD assignment (and separately the sole active Dept_Admin assignment) without an active replacement.
expected_result: Both attempts are blocked so the department never has zero active HOD or zero active Dept_Admin.

purpose: Verify that HOD and Dept_Admin role assignments with a valid time-bound validity interval are accepted and recorded.
preconditions: A department and eligible institute employees exist; an authenticated central Institute Admin exists.
action_or_input: Central Institute Admin creates or updates an HOD assignment and a Dept_Admin assignment specifying a valid effective validity interval (start before end).
expected_result: Both assignments succeed and their effective validity intervals are recorded and enforced.

purpose: Verify that HOD or Dept_Admin role assignments missing a validity interval or specifying an invalid interval are rejected.
preconditions: A department and eligible institute employee exist; an authenticated central Institute Admin exists.
action_or_input: Central Institute Admin attempts to create or update an HOD or Dept_Admin assignment without a validity interval, or with an invalid interval (e.g., end date/time on or before start date/time).
expected_result: The assignment is rejected with a validation error and no invalid role assignment is saved.

purpose: Verify that when an HOD or Dept_Admin reassignment takes effect, the outgoing user's role access is immediately revoked (no grace period) and the incoming user's role access is immediately granted.
preconditions: Department has an active outgoing HOD (or Dept_Admin) and an eligible incoming employee; central Institute Admin performs a role reassignment that takes effect immediately.
action_or_input: Immediately after the reassignment becomes effective, both the outgoing user and the incoming user attempt a role-restricted operation (e.g., HOD approving a pending stock request or Dept_Admin issuing an HOD-approved stock request).
expected_result: The outgoing user is immediately denied role-restricted access with no grace/overlap period, and the incoming user is immediately permitted to perform the role-restricted operation.
